title: Chart quiz #9
caption:
Chart quiz #9. No peeking at the reveal.

Q1: Name the pattern
Q2: Gap fill, or gap and go?
Q3: Which line is real support?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #ChartPatterns #Earnings #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Tops, gaps and levels. Question one. Price has hit the same high twice, and it's starting to roll over. What's the pattern? A double top, a bull flag, or a triangle? A double top. Two failed pushes at the same high, then the neckline broke. Until that neckline breaks, it's only a possible double top. Question two. Earnings came out, and the stock gapped up. Will the gap fill, or will it gap and go? It filled. Volume faded after the open, and long upper wicks showed sellers waiting above. Gaps on strong, rising volume are more likely to keep going. Question three. Price is falling again, with three lines drawn underneath. Which one is real support? A, B, or C? B. Buyers stepped in at that level three times before, so traders are watching it. A and C are just lines on a chart. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
